decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records that the approved Hero V must remain unchanged as the fixed reference during accent alignment and surrounding-wordmark refinement.
A same-message MODIFY already records that the accent and surrounding letters must adapt to the unchanged approved Hero V during complete-wordmark refinement.
A same-message MODIFY already fully captures that the accent must be adapted or repositioned to the fixed approved Hero V while preserving the required shared peak height.
The existing state already requires the second V to derive without distortion from the exact approved Hero V geometry; the source does not establish a new second-V value or hierarchy rule.
Restoring and preserving the approved Hero V geometry does not change the broader brand-purpose, tone, luxury, or expression requirements.
The source concerns geometric restoration and alignment, not the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its role.
The source preserves the approved Hero V as the alignment reference but does not modify the existing shared terminal gesture, its construction, or its application.
The geometric correction does not alter the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
